channel.description: Latest articles from The Logical Indian (thelogicalindian.com)

item.title: Bengaluru Couple Forced to Attend Own Wedding Reception Virtually After IndiGo Flight Cancellation Chaos
item.description: A couple joined their wedding reception via video after IndiGo cancelled flights amid a crew shortage crisis.

item.title: IndiGo Cancels 1,600 Flights in Crisis: Railways Adds 166 Coaches, 114 Trips to Aid Stranded Millions
item.description: Indian Railways deploys 166 extra coaches across 37 premium trains for over 114 trips, offering vital relief to passengers stranded by IndiGo's 1,600+ flight cancellations due to crew shortages and new regulations.

item.title: Booked on IndiGo? Avoid Airport Chaos – Here’s How To Check Live Status and Claim Refunds Easily From Home
item.description: Amid widespread IndiGo cancellations and delays, passengers can avoid airport chaos by checking status and securing refunds or rebooking online.

item.title: Indian Railways to Automatically Allot Lower Berths to Senior Citizens and Women Above 45 Based on Availability
item.description: Railway Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw confirmed automatic lower berth allocation for vulnerable groups.

item.title: Nitish Kumar Enters World Book of Records for Record 10th Oath as Bihar Chief Minister Since Independence
item.description: Bihar CM Nitish Kumar achieves a global first by taking chief ministerial oath 10 times, praised for stable governance and public trust.

item.title: Over 3000 Indians Deported From the U.S. in 2025 – Highest in 16 Years
item.description: India verifies nationality before accepting 3,258 deportees from the US in 2025, the highest in 16 years, as ties balance enforcement and humanity.​

item.title: Govt Orders IndiGo to Clear All Refunds by 8 PM Sunday; Imposes Zero Rescheduling Fees
item.description: Government orders IndiGo to refund all disrupted passengers by Sunday amid 1,000+ cancellations from crew shortages and FDTL rules.

item.title: “She Can Stay For As Long As She Wants”: FM Jaishankar on Exiled Sheikh Hasina Living in India
item.description: India’s External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar affirmed on December 6, 2025, that the indefinite stay of former Bangladesh Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina remains her personal choice, following her flight from Dhaka amid deadly 2024 protests that ended her 15-year rule. The 78-year-old former leader is currently living in India despite an extradition demand from the […]

item.title: IndiGo Flight Chaos Grips Airports as DGCA Suspends Pilot Duty Rules Amid Crew Shortages and Delays
item.description: IndiGo's crew shortages from new pilot rest rules led to over 1,800 cancellations, prompting DGCA to suspend norms and government to mandate passenger aid until operations stabilise.

item.title: India Announces Free 30-Day E-Tourist Visas for Russians, Boosting Ties Post Putin-Modi Summit
item.description: India's free 30-day e-tourist visas for Russians promise smoother travel and stronger bilateral bonds after the Modi-Putin summit.
